name: Methi Malai Tofu
ingredients: 2 cups fresh methi leaves, washed and chopped
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Blanch the methi for 1 minute to remove bitterness; squeeze dry.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 minutes. Blend with the silken tofu and coconut milk to a smooth paste.
Return to the pan with ½ cup water and turmeric; simmer for 4 minutes.
Add the tofu cubes and methi and simmer for 5 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and salt.
note: Tofu replaces paneer and the blended base replaces cream. Blanching mellows the methi bitterness.
